decision.observed_event: You declare: "Kit, before this: I set off the wailing staff in 6a, then went around through 6b and kicked that rigged door."

improv_read.player_bid: The player tells Kit what happened in the rooms before.
improv_read.connection: The noise from 6a and 6b warned the card room before she arrived.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit takes the player history at face value and lets it change how the table greets her.

public_brief.objective: Meet a loud intruder already braced.
public_brief.tactic: Stop the game and wait, hands near weapons, for whoever made the noise.
public_brief.visible_cue: The cards lie abandoned while hands go under the table.
public_brief.player_opening: The player can walk in, call out, or wait.
public_brief.reply_to: Kit, before this: I set off the wailing staff in 6a, then went around through 6b and kicked that rigged door.
public_brief.kit_focus: Acknowledge the history plainly, then show the table already braced for the noise.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, no humor: confirm, then set the braced room

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: And the room has heard you. The cards lie face down and abandoned on the table. The dealer is half out of his chair, staring at the doorway, and the two players nearest it have their hands under the table, out of sight. Only the fourth player has not moved at all.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Got it: the wailing staff went off in 6a and you kicked the rigged door in 6b, so you have been loud the whole way here. I'll play the card room with that history in it. Do you go on in?
segments.reacts_to: I set off the wailing staff in 6a
